purpose: Constrained OWASP ZAP Access Control Testing for the authorized local VAmPI teaching lab.
execution_requirements: Use an ephemeral ZAP session bound only to 127.0.0.1:8080.
Do not import the full OpenAPI specification.
Seed the ZAP site tree manually with only the exact allowed_requests.
Configure a ZAP Context whose full-match include regexes contain only the exact allowed_requests.
Configure users and Access Control rules before a scan.
Inspect the resulting request queue and stop if any method or URL falls outside allowed_requests.
Do not export Authorization headers, bearer tokens, or full secret-bearing response bodies.
Remove the ZAP container and session data after the assessment.
stop_conditions: Any request method other than GET appears in the context, history, or scan queue.
Any URL outside the two approved local book fixture paths appears in the context or scan queue.
A required Access Control user or rule cannot be verified before scan start.
